sections.heading: Inner current loop
sections.text: Per-switch peak-current sensing with leading-edge blanking (100-300ns). Current-loop bandwidth: f_ci ~ fsw/5. Slope compensation: ramp >= V_out*N_pri/N_sec / (2*L_out*fsw). The split-capacitor midpoint drifts if current sensing is asymmetric.

sections.heading: Outer voltage loop
sections.text: Output ripple frequency = 2*fsw. Voltage-loop crossover: f_cv ~ 2*fsw/10 to 2*fsw/20. PI compensator. The split-capacitor midpoint voltage should be monitored — if it drifts more than 5% from V_in/2, the current sensing or duty cycle is asymmetric.

sections.heading: Revision note
sections.text: If the half-bridge shows split-capacitor midpoint drift, verify: (1) per-switch current sensing (not averaged), (2) equal blanking times, (3) symmetric gate drive. If leakage inductance causes voltage spikes, add an RCD snubber or active clamp.
